agentsMemory.heading: Agents and memory
agentsMemory.label: Agents & memory
agentsMemory.meta: what an agent session receives, and what it leaves behind
agentsMemory.mcpToolsNote: read its ticket, comment, change the status, ask a blocking question, file a finding — with no prose conventions. Off: new sessions start without the channel, running sessions do not move.
agentsMemory.visualProofNote: every build, pipeline or not: when the change is visible and a browser is at hand, the agent screenshots it and attaches it to the ticket. Best-effort, needs the Arij MCP tools and a runnable UI. Off by default.
agentsMemory.memoryDistill: Distil the memory after a successful build
agentsMemory.memoryDistillNote: a distillation agent merges the new conventions into the project memory, which is then injected into every prompt. Off by default.
agentsMemory.specRewrite: Rewrite the spec after every release
agentsMemory.specRewriteNote: when a release is published, a plan-mode agent rewrites the specification to match what actually shipped. Skipped during a manual update. Off by default.

mcp.heading: MCP servers
mcp.intro: Extra MCP servers (Godot, Confluence, Playwright…) handed to agent sessions and CLI chat conversations alongside Arij's own tool channel.
mcp.scopeProject: These are scoped to this project; global servers are inherited below.
mcp.scopeGlobal: These are global — every project's sessions get them.
mcp.strictConfig: Arij runs agents with strict MCP config, so servers configured in your own ~/.claude.json or .mcp.json are ignored: declare them here instead.
mcp.notChatMode: Not used by the OpenAI-compatible chat mode — it is an HTTP endpoint, not an MCP host, and keeps its own built-in board tools.

server.unsupportedProviders: Not honoured by {providers} — those CLIs only read a user-global MCP registry, so they receive global servers only. Secrets for those providers are stored in the CLI's own config file, readable by the agent.

inherited.heading: Inherited global servers
inherited.empty: No global MCP servers are configured.
inherited.partialDisable: Disabling this here will not affect {providers} — a per-project entry cannot reach a user-global MCP registry, so their sessions keep loading this server. Delete or disable it globally to stop it everywhere.
inherited.note: Inherited servers are read-only here — edit them in the global settings. To change one for this project only, disable it or add a local server with the same name: a project entry takes precedence — on the providers that read per-spawn config.

form.name: Name (lowercase, [a-z0-9_-])
form.usageHint: Usage hint — one line telling the agent what this server is for
form.agentTypes: Agent types (one per line) — blank means every type, chat included
form.toolAllowlist: Allowed tools (one per line) — blank means every tool the server exposes
form.secretsNote: — write-only. Leave blank to keep the stored values.
form.secretsPlaceholder: unchanged — type a line to replace a value
